sort.L1.source: each iteration either partitions a segment (at most n partitions) or insertion-sorts and pops a segment (at most n); n = 999 elements (harness, size patch)

sort.L1.body.if1.then.L1.source: j = l+1 .. ir with ir-l < M = 7

sort.L1.body.if1.then.L1.body.L1.source: i = j-1 .. l within a segment shorter than M = 7

sort.L1.body.if1.else.L1.source: one swap of a distinct pair per iteration, at most n/2 pairs

sort.L1.body.if1.else.L1.body.L1.source: i scans forward within the segment, at most n elements

sort.L1.body.if1.else.L1.body.L2.source: j scans backward within the segment, at most n elements
